title: Mindfulness Seminar 4
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk's main teaching emphasizes the importance of cultivating awareness of our feelings, or vedana, as a way to bring mindfulness into daily life. By paying attention to how we react to different experiences, we can begin to see through patterns of desire and aversion that contribute to suffering. This practice involves developing a baseline feeling tone beneath emotions and thoughts, allowing us to interact with our experiences in a more skillful and aware way.
